I have farmed this small piece for many years, but it is not my land, so I do not put money into it. I will plant the maize seed I kept from last year, and my wife and I will pull the weeds by hand when the rains come. I do not have cash for fertilizer or chemicals, and at my age I cannot carry water for irrigation, so I wait for the rain.
